title.en: Four tones and the neutral tone

intro.zh: 中文的每个音节都有声调：同一个音，声调不同，意思就不同（mā 妈、mǎ 马）。拼音上的小符号就是声调：ˉ ˊ ˇ ˋ，没有符号的是轻声。最后四个 shī shí shǐ shì 也只差一个声调，却是四个不同的字。
intro.en: Every Chinese syllable has a tone: the same sound with a different tone is a different word (mā mum, mǎ horse). The little mark over the vowel is the tone: ˉ ˊ ˇ ˋ, and no mark means the neutral tone. The last four, shī shí shǐ shì, differ only in tone, yet they are four different words.

items.zh: 第一声：又高又平，像拉长唱一个音。
items.en: 1st tone: high and flat, like holding one long note. mā = mum.

items.zh: 第二声：从中间往上扬，像吃惊地问「啊？」。
items.en: 2nd tone: rises from the middle to high, like asking "Huh?" má = numb.

items.zh: 第三声：先降下去再升上来，又低又沉；后面还有字时，常常只读低的那一半。
items.en: 3rd tone: low, dips down, then comes back up. Before another tone, just say the low part. mǎ = horse.

items.zh: 第四声：从高处很快降到最低，像干脆地说「不！」。
items.en: 4th tone: falls fast from high to low, like a firm "No!" mà = to scold.

items.zh: 轻声：又轻又短，不标调号。「吗」放在句子最后，就变成问句。
items.en: Neutral tone: short and light, with no mark. ma at the end turns a sentence into a yes/no question.

items.zh: 第一声：老师的「师」。
items.en: 1st tone: as in lǎo shī (teacher).

items.zh: 第二声：数字「十」。
items.en: 2nd tone: ten.

items.zh: 第三声：历史的「史」。
items.en: 3rd tone: as in lì shǐ (history).

items.zh: 第四声：「我是学生」的「是」。
items.en: 4th tone: to be (am, is, are).

intro.zh: 声母是音节开头的那个音，很多和英语差不多。要注意送气：b d g 不送气，p t k 嘴前要有一股气。j q x、zh ch sh r、z c s 英语里没有一模一样的，看看提示、多听几遍。
intro.en: Initials are the sounds at the start of a syllable, and many are close to English. Watch the puff of air: b d g have none, p t k have a strong one. j q x, zh ch sh r and z c s have no exact English match, so read the tips and listen.

items.zh: 不送气：嘴前没有一股气。
items.en: Like the p in "spin": no puff of air.

items.zh: 送气：手放在嘴前，能感到一股气。
items.en: Like the p in "pie", with a strong puff of air.

items.zh: 舌尖抵住上牙床，不送气。
items.en: Like the t in "stop": no puff of air.

items.zh: 和 d 一样的位置，要送气。
items.en: Like the t in "top", with a strong puff of air.

items.zh: 舌根抬起，不送气。
items.en: Like the k in "sky": no puff of air.

items.zh: 和 g 一样的位置，要送气。
items.en: Like the k in "kite", with a strong puff of air.

items.zh: 舌根抬高，气从舌根和上颚中间擦出来。
items.en: Rougher than English h: a light scrape at the back of the mouth.

items.zh: 舌面贴近上牙床，嘴角往两边咧；后面只跟 i 和 ü。
items.en: Like the j in "jeep", tongue flat and lips in a smile. Only before i and ü.

items.zh: 和 j 一样的位置，要送气。
items.en: Like the ch in "cheese", with a puff of air. Never "kw"!

items.zh: 和 j 一样的位置，气从舌面上擦出来。
items.en: Like the sh in "she", tongue flat and lips in a smile.

items.zh: 舌尖往上卷，顶住上牙床后面，不送气。
items.en: Like the j in "jar", with the tongue tip curled back.

items.zh: 和 zh 一样卷舌，要送气。
items.en: Like the ch in "chart", tongue tip curled back, with a puff of air.

items.zh: 舌尖往上卷，气从中间擦出来。
items.en: Like the sh in "shop", with the tongue tip curled back.

items.zh: 和 sh 一样卷舌，声带要振动。
items.en: Like the s in "pleasure", with the tongue tip curled back.

items.zh: 舌尖抵住上门牙背后，不送气。
items.en: Like the ds in "kids".

items.zh: 和 z 一样的位置，要送气。
items.en: Like the ts in "cats", with a puff of air. Never "k"!

items.zh: zi ci si、zhi chi shi ri 里的 i 不读「衣」，只把前面的音拉长。
items.en: In si (and zi ci, zhi chi shi ri) the i is not "ee": just keep the buzz going.

items.zh: 前面没有声母、以 i 或 ü 开头的音节写 y：yi、ya、yu。
items.en: Written when a syllable starts with i or ü and has no initial: yi, ya, yu. Like English y.

items.zh: 前面没有声母、以 u 开头的音节写 w：wu、wa、wo。
items.en: Written when a syllable starts with u and has no initial: wu, wa, wo. Like English w.

intro.zh: 韵母是声母后面的部分，声调符号就标在韵母上。先学 a o e i u ü 六个，别的都是它们拼起来的，有的后面带 -n 或 -ng。-n 和 -ng 不一样，意思也不一样：船 chuán、床 chuáng。
intro.en: Finals are the part after the initial, and the tone mark sits on them. Learn a o e i u ü first; the rest are built from them, some ending in -n or -ng. -n and -ng make different words: chuán (boat), chuáng (bed).

items.zh: 嘴张大。
items.en: Mouth wide open, like the a in "father".

items.zh: 嘴唇拢圆；在 b p m f 后面听起来像 wo。
items.en: Round lips, like the aw in "saw". After b p m f it sounds like "wo".

items.zh: 嘴半开，嘴唇不圆，舌头往后缩。
items.en: Not the e in "bed"! Say "uh" from the back, lips not rounded.

items.zh: 说 e 的时候舌尖往上卷。
items.en: Like the er in American "her", tongue tip curled up.

items.zh: 嘴角往两边咧；在 z c s zh ch sh r 后面不读「衣」。
items.en: Like the ee in "see". After z c s zh ch sh r it is not "ee" (see s).

items.zh: 嘴唇拢圆、往前突。
items.en: Like the oo in "food", lips round and pushed forward.

items.zh: 先说 i，舌头不动，把嘴唇拢圆。
items.en: Say "ee", then round your lips without moving your tongue. Not "oo"!

items.zh: 从 a 滑到 i。
items.en: Like "eye".

items.zh: 从 e 滑到 i。
items.en: Like the ay in "day".

items.zh: 从 a 滑到 o。
items.en: Like the ow in "cow".

items.zh: 从 o 滑到 u。
items.en: Like the o in "go".

items.zh: 前鼻音：最后舌尖抵住上牙床。
items.en: Like "ahn", ending with the tongue tip up.

items.zh: 前鼻音：最后舌尖抵住上牙床。
items.en: Like the un in "fun", not the en in "ten".

items.zh: 后鼻音：最后舌根抬起。
items.en: Like "ahng", ending at the back of the mouth.

items.zh: 后鼻音：最后舌根抬起。
items.en: Like the ung in "lung".

items.zh: 嘴唇拢圆的后鼻音。
items.en: Like "oong", with round lips.

items.zh: i 很快滑到 a。
items.en: Like "ya".

items.zh: i 很快滑到 e，听起来像「耶」。
items.en: Like the ye in "yes".

items.zh: i 很快滑到 ao。
items.en: Like "yow".

items.zh: 是 iou 的简写。
items.en: Short for iou: liù sounds like "l-yo".

items.zh: 听起来像「烟」，a 在这里读得很窄。
items.en: Sounds like "yen", not "yan"!

items.zh: 前鼻音，收在舌尖。
items.en: Like "een", ending with the tongue tip up.

items.zh: i 很快滑到 ang。
items.en: Like "yahng".

items.zh: 后鼻音，收在舌根。
items.en: Like the ing in "sing".

items.zh: 嘴唇拢圆，像「拥」。
items.en: Like "yoong", with round lips.

items.zh: u 很快滑到 a。
items.en: Like "wa".

items.zh: u 很快滑到 o。
items.en: Like "wo", with round lips.

items.zh: u 很快滑到 ai。
items.en: Like "why".

items.zh: 是 uei 的简写。
items.en: Short for uei: shuǐ sounds like "sh-way".

items.zh: u 很快滑到 an；j q x y 后面的 uan 其实是 üan。
items.en: Like "wahn". After j q x y it is really üan.

items.zh: 是 uen 的简写；j q x y 后面的 un 其实是 ün。
items.en: Short for uen: chūn sounds like "ch-wun". After j q x y it is really ün.

items.zh: u 很快滑到 ang。
items.en: Like "wahng".

items.zh: ü 滑到 e；在 j q x y 后面写成 ue。
items.en: ü + eh. After j q x y it is written ue: xuě.

items.zh: 写成 yuan、juan、quan、xuan。
items.en: ü + an, said like "ü-en". Written yuan, juan, quan, xuan.

items.zh: 写成 yun、jun、qun、xun。
items.en: ü + n. Written yun, jun, qun, xun.

intro.zh: 声母 + 韵母 + 声调 = 一个音节，一个汉字就是一个音节。没有声母时，开头写成 y 或 w（yi、wu、yu）。j q x 和 y 后面的 ü 去掉两点写成 u（ju、qu、xu、yu），读音还是 ü。
intro.en: Initial + final + tone = one syllable, and each character is one syllable. With no initial, the syllable starts with y or w (yi, wu, yu). After j, q, x and y, ü loses its dots (ju, qu, xu, yu) but is still said ü.

items.zh: n + i + 第三声 = nǐ，h + ao + 第三声 = hǎo。
items.en: n + i + 3rd tone = nǐ; h + ao + 3rd tone = hǎo.

items.zh: x + ie + 第四声 = xiè；第二个 xie 是轻声，不标调号。
items.en: x + ie + 4th tone = xiè; the second xie is neutral, with no mark.

items.zh: z + ai + 第四声 = zài，j + ian + 第四声 = jiàn。
items.en: z + ai = zài; j + ian = jiàn (ian sounds like "yen").

items.zh: x + üe = xué：x 后面的 ü 写成 u，读音还是 ü。sheng 是轻声。
items.en: x + üe = xué: after x, ü is written u but still said ü. sheng is neutral.

items.zh: 没有声母，uan 写成 wan；ān 只有韵母。
items.en: No initial, so uan is written wan; ān is just the final an.

items.zh: 没有声母，ü 写成 yu，读音还是 ü。
items.en: No initial, so ü is written yu. It is still the ü sound, not "you".

intro.zh: 说话的时候，有几个声调会变。两个第三声连在一起，拼音不改，只是读法变了；「一」和「不」的拼音照读出来的写。轻声又短又轻，不标调号。
intro.en: In real speech some tones change. With two 3rd tones together, the pinyin stays the same and only the sound changes. For yī (one) and bù (not), this course writes the tone you actually say. The neutral tone is short and light, with no mark.

items.zh: 两个第三声连在一起，前一个读成第二声；拼音还是写第三声。
items.en: Two 3rd tones in a row: say the first one as a 2nd tone. The pinyin still shows two 3rd tones.

items.zh: 「一」在第四声前面读 yí，拼音照读音写。
items.en: Before a 4th tone, yī becomes yí, and is written yí.

items.zh: 「一」在第一、二、三声前面读 yì；单说、数数、说日期时还是 yī。
items.en: Before 1st, 2nd and 3rd tones, yī becomes yì. Alone, in counting and in dates it stays yī.

items.zh: 「不」在第四声前面读 bú；在别的声调前面还是 bù（不好 bù hǎo）。
items.en: Before a 4th tone, bù becomes bú. Before other tones it stays bù (bù hǎo, not good).

items.zh: 轻声又短又轻，不标调号：很多词的第二个字，还有吗、的、子这些小字；词中间的「不」也读轻声。
items.en: Neutral tone: short and light, with no mark. It comes on the second syllable of many words and on little words like ma, de, zi; bu in the middle of a word is neutral too.
